diagram_candidates.claim: Identity strands I, adjacent crossing X, cap A, and cup U generate the R-linear Brauer category; their involution, braid, cup-cap, snake, and reflected relations are complete for equality of scaled Brauer matchings.
diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The statement gives a finite list of local relations, and the proof explicitly verifies them by tracking boundary pairs and reduces regular expressions by cup-train moves. A small relation panel would make each domain/codomain and local replacement easier to compare.
diagram_candidates.specific_content: Draw objects as strand counts; show X:2→2 with X²=I⊗² and the three-strand braid relation; show A:2→0 and U:0→2 with AU=δ1₀ and (A⊗I)(I⊗U)=I plus reflected snake; include the cap-slide/cup-train moves used in lines 49–51. Preserve stacking/composition order and put loop scalar δ only on the closed component.
diagram_candidates.mathematical_status: The statement and local proof relations were checked against the source. The candidate is explanatory; no relation defect was found.

diagram_candidates.claim: The BMW presentation has braid and distant commutation relations, cup-cap interactions, skein relation gᵢ−gᵢ⁻¹=z(1−eᵢ), untwisting gᵢeᵢ=ρ⁻¹eᵢ, and loop relation eᵢ²=δeᵢ, with z(δ−1)=ρ−ρ⁻¹.
diagram_candidates.why_warranted: These are local tangle-style relations stated algebraically, and a small before/after tangle panel could make the fixed Kauffman convention and the eᵢ cup-cap role more concrete.
diagram_candidates.specific_content: Draw the crossing gᵢ, inverse crossing gᵢ⁻¹, and cup-cap eᵢ in the same two-strand rectangle; check the coefficient/sign in gᵢ−gᵢ⁻¹=z(1−eᵢ), the scalar ρ⁻¹ in gᵢeᵢ=ρ⁻¹eᵢ, and δ on eᵢ². Explicitly retain the stated z(δ−1)=ρ−ρ⁻¹ convention without dividing by z.
diagram_candidates.mathematical_status: A candidate for exposition only; rendered formulas are legible and no convention/sign defect was confirmed.
